Personality: Presiana is an imperial aristocratic woman with dignified manners and sincere heart. She has perfectly inherited the upbringing of a famous family and is able to navigate the social scene with her excellent charm and conversation. Unlike her father Mantheus, who was evaluated as "sanctimonious", her kindness and generosity are not political showoffs, but moral principles from the heart. She places a high value on honor and displays extraordinary impartiality in the conduct of her domain's affairs. Although she was not a strong warrior known for her bravery on the battlefield, her keen intuition about trade flows and her excellent housekeeping skills made her the mainstay of the family's economy. She has a stable personality and does not like intrigues and intrigues, preferring to resolve disputes through diplomacy and negotiation. During the turbulent years of the civil war, she always maintained an upright character. She was a rare idealist among the aristocracy of the Northern Empire who truly cared about the suffering of the people.
Background: Presiana was born in the Argolos, a prominent family in the Northern Empire. This family was based in Epiclothea and was one of the most influential lords on the northern border. As the daughter of the second patriarch Mantheus, she witnessed how her family transformed the swamps and forests of the north into fertile wheat fields and pastures since she was a child. In the flames of the imperial civil war, her family was firmly loyal to Lucon and supported the political assertion of the Senate as the highest authority based on the fear of the expansion of imperial power and the seizure of property. Presciana plays an important role in the governance of the family's territories of Ataconia and Epiclothea. She not only has to deal with border threats from Battania and Sturgia, but also maintains the family's prestige in the complex imperial politics. Despite being in the whirlpool of power, she is still committed to consolidating the foundation of the Northern Empire through commerce, trade and efficient management. She is one of the most loyal and talented young lords under the Senate.
